registry_semantics: Implemented means represented in the current strict Farm contract and enforced or accounted for by the cited planning and replay paths. It does not mean agronomically validated on a real farm.

implemented.capability: Four recipe-backed leafy crops in sheltered hydroponics
implemented.contract: Recipe.crop_id is caixin, pak_choi, kailan, or lettuce; Recipe.system and Bed.system are sheltered_hydroponic.
implemented.limitations: Other catalogue crops are presentation/evidence records and cannot enter the planner contract. Recipe coefficients remain synthetic demo values.

implemented.contract: Each allocation uses exactly the declared bed area and has one sow, transplant, and harvest date.
implemented.limitations: No split beds, partial area, intercropping, succession within one allocation, or multi-cut regrowth.

implemented.contract: transplant_date - sow_date >= nursery_days and harvest_date - transplant_date >= grow_days.
implemented.limitations: Schedule elapsed time is not a physiological biomass, pest, disease, or weather-response model.

implemented.capability: Daily bed exclusivity from transplant through sanitation
implemented.contract: A bed is occupied on every civil day from transplant through harvest + sanitation_days, inclusive; it is next available the following day.
implemented.limitations: Nursery activity is capacity-accounted but does not occupy the production bed before transplant.

implemented.contract: Whole-plant sites equal ceil(bed area * recipe density) for each nursery day.
implemented.limitations: No tray geometry, germination loss, nursery zones, or cultivar-specific site sharing.

implemented.capability: Weekly sow and harvest labour capacity
implemented.contract: Sow labour is area-based; harvest labour is marketable-kg-based and reserved at the maximum declared scenario yield factor.
implemented.limitations: No daily shifts, skills, worker identities, overtime bands, breaks, task travel, transplant labour, or sanitation labour.

implemented.contract: Candidate selection limits recipe input spend by policy capital fraction; FEASIBLE output additionally requires every declared scenario's total modeled input, sow/harvest labour, packing, and disposal cost to fit Farm.resources.cash_sgd.
enforcement: main mission accepts only FEASIBLE strategies
implemented.limitations: Rates are declared fixture constants or recipe coefficients. Revenue timing does not finance new candidates within the same horizon, and no credit, payable, tax, depreciation, or general overhead model exists.

implemented.capability: Immutable executed work and active replan locks
implemented.contract: Existing Farm batches and supplied locked allocations must remain byte-equivalent in every validated continuation; new sowing can be bounded to a future date.
implemented.limitations: Only the declared sow/transplant/harvest/sanitation task model is preserved; no arbitrary field-work dependency graph exists.

implemented.contract: A reservation names one bed and an inclusive start/end date within the horizon; same-bed reservation windows cannot overlap.
implemented.limitations: Reservations are planner API inputs used by research branching and are not a general maintenance-resource model.

implemented.contract: Finite nonnegative weights and factors are normalized to 1000 integer objective units. Yield affects harvest; demand factor affects residual forecast only and never shrinks booked orders.
implemented.limitations: Scenarios are declared synthetic sensitivities, not calibrated probabilities, prediction intervals, or correlated stochastic processes.

implemented.capability: Order-level due-date demand and cancellation netting
implemented.contract: Only orders booked by the cutoff enter the snapshot. Net booked quantity is quantity minus cancellations and is serviced on its due date.
implemented.limitations: The order schema has no buyer, grade, service-window, substitution, minimum-fill, lateness, or contractual-priority field. Known higher price and stable ID are deterministic tie-breakers, not buyer preference claims.

implemented.contract: Lots carry crop, quantity, harvest date, and expiry date. Expired stock is disposed before same-day service; allocation sorts by expiry, harvest date, then lot ID.
implemented.limitations: No grade, storage zone, temperature history, commingling, recall, shrink other than explicit expiry, or manual lot choice.

implemented.capability: Explicit physical stock at the planning horizon
implemented.contract: Usable or expiring closing lots remain terminal inventory with zero salvage value and a separate declared policy penalty.
implemented.limitations: Terminal inventory is not automatically sold, discarded, or valued.

implemented.capability: Durable daily synthetic execution and local replanning
implemented.contract: World advance commits scheduled tasks, lot movements, explicit-price revenue, modeled costs, cash, and one day-close event per civil day under tenant locking and idempotency receipts.
implemented.limitations: Events are synthetic schedule execution. They are not observed farm operations, sensor measurements, or permission to actuate equipment.

unsupported.capability: Water, nutrient, electricity, lighting, pumps, cooling, and HVAC constraints
unsupported.current_behavior: Absent from contracts, solver, costs, and replay.

ui_and_tests: resource timelines with units and provenance

unsupported.capability: Seed, substrate, nutrient, packaging, and other consumable stock
unsupported.current_behavior: Recipe input cost is monetary only; no item quantities, lead times, lots, or stockouts exist.

execution: receive, reserve, consume, waste, and adjustment events

unsupported.capability: Grades, quality loss, pack formats, and packhouse throughput
unsupported.current_behavior: Marketable yield is one already-packed endpoint and packing is only a flat delivered-kg cost.

execution: weigh, grade, reject, pack, and dispatch events

unsupported.capability: Rotation, disease, pest, cleaning, and biosecurity rules beyond fixed sanitation days
unsupported.current_behavior: Only an unconditional recipe sanitation interval is represented.

execution: inspection, incident, treatment, clearance, and cleaning evidence

unsupported.capability: Multiple harvests and regrowth from one planting
unsupported.current_behavior: Every allocation has exactly one harvest; the bed enters sanitation immediately afterward.

execution: one observed harvest lot per cut
ui_and_tests: capacity and mass tests across all cuts

unsupported.capability: Partner-farm supply, spot purchases, transfers, and substitutions
unsupported.current_behavior: Supply comes only from opening inventory and the farm's declared allocations.

execution: purchase approval, receipt, rejection, and payable events

unsupported.capability: Buyer priority, delivery windows, minimum fill, substitutions, penalties, routes, and vehicle capacity
unsupported.current_behavior: Order ID, crop, exact due date, net kg, and explicit price are the supported commercial fields.

solver: routing/loading or an explicit downstream optimizer boundary
execution: pick, dispatch, proof-of-delivery, rejection, and penalty events
ui_and_tests: window, priority, and route conflict tests

unsupported.capability: Bed subdivision, intercropping, vertical layers, fields, and production systems beyond sheltered hydroponics
unsupported.current_behavior: Each decision consumes one whole declared bed in one fixed system.

validation: nonoverlapping geometry or explicit capacity partition
solver: integer spatial units or audited discretization

unsupported.capability: Daily worker shifts, skills, overtime, task dependencies, and absences
unsupported.current_behavior: One aggregate weekly labour-hours ceiling covers sow and worst-scenario harvest labour only.

solver: daily assignment or explicit capacity handoff
execution: assigned, started, completed, corrected, and absent events

unsupported.capability: Validated farm-specific yield, maturity, spoilage, and uncertainty models
unsupported.current_behavior: Recipe values, scenario factors, and shelf lives are synthetic declarations. Schedule progress is elapsed time only.

solver: frozen calibrated distributions or uncertainty sets

expansion_rule: A capability remains unsupported until its units and point-in-time fields are in the strict contract, invalid states fail validation, the solver and deterministic replay share the same semantics, the UI exposes the assumption and provenance, and adversarial plus conservation tests pass.
